name: unscreened corpus probe (20->10, monthly)
description: Isolates the news-corpus variable. Identical to fresh_news_hold_winners.json except screened_news=false and freqs=[12]. Tests whether the LLM relevance screen explains the 13.7pp gap between Paper A and Paper B measuring the same quantity.
notes: WHY THIS EXISTS: the two papers disagree about the same measurement.
Paper A, 20->10 pick-and-hold, gpt-5.1, tech, 12mo   60.57%  (n=70)
Paper B, INIT at 20->10 (same thing)                 46.91%  (n=324)
gap                                                 -13.66pp
Yet the two agree almost exactly in aggregate - Paper A's all-config
run-weighted mean is 47.01% against Paper B's INIT 46.91%, a 0.10pp
difference. So the pipelines are not broadly inconsistent; something specific
separates the flagship figure.
THREE CANDIDATE CAUSES:
1. SELECTION INFLATION. Paper A's 60.57% is the maximum over ten configs
chosen on the same windows used to score them. Paper B never had a menu
and reproduces the MEAN but not the MAXIMUM - the signature of inflation.
Already disclosed in the manuscript's Limitations.
2. CORPUS. Paper A's runs read the unscreened corpus; Paper B reads
tech_screened_corpus.csv (1,547 articles, 13.7% pass rate). THIS PRESET
TESTS THAT ONE.
3. ORDER MODE. Paper A used dollar orders, Paper B uses weights mode.
WHY IT MATTERS BEYOND PAPER B: the NHSJS manuscript states that screened
articles are 'stored in a curated database and reused downstream, letting a
small, high-quality input set drive strategy generation'. If the unscreened
corpus produces BETTER picks, that claim needs qualifying - and it is a claim
already under reviewer scrutiny (Recommended #5 asked for screen validation).
If the screened corpus is at least as good, the claim stands and cause 2 is
eliminated, leaving selection inflation as the explanation.
READ THE **INIT** COLUMN, NOT THE STRATEGY COLUMN. INIT is the period-0 pick
held for 12 months, which is exactly what Paper A measures. The live strategy
number carries the reinvestment penalty and is not comparable to Paper A.
hold_winners @12x INIT (screened)   45.60%   <- the control
this arm's INIT (unscreened)        ?
GATE NOTE: min_articles=50/90d is kept identical to the control for a clean
contrast, but it measures whichever corpus the run reads (see _news_dates), so
on the raw corpus it will not bind. That is intended - the gate exists to stop
starved cells, and the raw corpus is not starved.
9 windows x 3 runs x 1 cadence = 27 runs, roughly 10 minutes.
dry_run is FALSE: this preset SPENDS BUDGET the moment it is started.
